# Maxio

> Maxio is a comprehensive billing and financial operations platform for B2B SaaS companies, providing subscription billing, revenue recognition, usage-based pricing, and investor-grade financial reporting.

Maxio serves B2B SaaS companies with integrated solutions for billing automation, revenue management, and financial compliance. The platform supports complex billing models including usage-based pricing, handles ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance, and offers AI-powered capabilities for billing and revenue data governance.

## Key Topics

- SaaS Billing
- Revenue Recognition (ASC 606, IFRS 15)
- Usage-Based Billing
- Subscription Management
- SaaS Metrics & Reporting
- Payment Processing
- Invoicing Automation
- Accounts Receivable
- CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote)
- Financial Compliance
- Payment Integrations (Stripe, GoCardless, PayPal)
- AI-Powered Billing
- Recurring Revenue (ARR)
- Deferred Revenue
- Customer Retention

## Core Platform

- [Billing and Financial Operations for B2B SaaS](https://www.maxio.com): Maxio platform for SaaS billing, revenue recognition, and financial operations
- [Subscription Billing Software](https://www.maxio.com/billing): Maxio subscription billing: invoicing, subscriptions, and SaaS metrics
- [Subscription Management Software](https://www.maxio.com/subscription-management): Maxio subscription management: recurring revenue and billing automation
- [Revenue Recognition Software](https://www.maxio.com/revenue-recognition): Maxio revenue recognition: ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance automation

## Billing & Pricing Solutions

- [Usage-Based Billing Software](https://www.maxio.com/billing/usage-based-billing-software): Maxio usage-based billing: launch and scale dynamic pricing models
- [CPQ: Configure, Price, Quote](https://www.maxio.com/cpq): Maxio CPQ: quote-to-cash automation with approval workflows and integrations
- [Accounts Receivable Management](https://www.maxio.com/product/accounts-receivable-management): Maxio A/R: automated invoicing, collections, and payment processing
- [Invoicing Software for SaaS Finance Teams](https://www.maxio.com/use-cases/never-miss-an-invoice): Maxio invoicing: SaaS-specific billing automation and collections
